roles.description: Data Scientists extract insights from data using statistical methods, machine learning, and business acumen to drive decision-making.

interviewPipeline.name: Recruiter Screen
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: Background fit, salary expectations, role alignment

interviewPipeline.name: Technical Phone Screen
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: SQL queries, probability/statistics, Python, basic ML concepts

interviewPipeline.name: Onsite: Technical Deep Dive
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: ML algorithms, statistics, experimental design, coding

interviewPipeline.name: Onsite: Case Study
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: Real-world data problem, business impact framing

0-1.label: Entry Level
0-1.technicalExpectation: Basic JOINs, GROUP BY, explain algorithms conceptually, implement basic models with sklearn

2-4.label: Mid Level
2-4.technicalExpectation: Window functions, CTEs, end-to-end pipeline ownership, experimental design
2-4.behavioralFocus: Independent execution, cross-functional collaboration, project ownership

5-9.label: Senior
5-9.technicalExpectation: Complex queries, system design for ML, novel problem framing, causal inference
5-9.behavioralFocus: Leadership without authority, mentoring, strategic communication

10+.label: Staff+
10+.technicalExpectation: Architecture-level data modeling, define ML strategy, methodology innovation

feedbackDimensions.name: Content Quality
feedbackDimensions.description: Accuracy, depth, relevance, use of specific examples

feedbackDimensions.name: Structure & Organization
feedbackDimensions.description: Logical flow, use of frameworks, time management

feedbackDimensions.name: Communication Clarity
feedbackDimensions.description: Conciseness, appropriate jargon level, simplification ability

feedbackDimensions.name: Business Acumen
feedbackDimensions.description: Connecting analysis to business impact, stakeholder awareness

feedbackDimensions.name: Technical Depth
feedbackDimensions.description: Understanding of underlying concepts, not just surface-level knowledge

resume.achievementFraming: Quantify model performance (accuracy, AUC, lift). Frame business impact ('Increased retention by 12% through churn model'). Show end-to-end project ownership.
resume.formatConventions: 1-2 pages. Projects section is critical. Publications/GitHub if applicable. Education matters for entry level.

avoid: Pure technical jargon without business context

roles.description: Software Engineers design, build, and maintain software systems that power applications and services.

interviewPipeline.name: Onsite: Coding (2-3 rounds)
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: DSA, optimization, medium to hard difficulty

0-1.label: New Grad / Junior
0-1.technicalExpectation: Solve medium problems cleanly with hints. 150-200 practice problems recommended.

2-4.label: Mid
2-4.technicalExpectation: Solve medium-hard independently. Optimize solutions. Discuss trade-offs.

5-9.label: Senior
5-9.technicalExpectation: Solve hard problems. Focus on code design, extensibility, testing.

10+.label: Staff+
10+.technicalExpectation: Architecture-level coding. Define patterns and standards.
10+.behavioralFocus: Org influence, tech vision, culture building

feedbackDimensions.name: Code Correctness
feedbackDimensions.description: Solution works for all cases including edge cases

feedbackDimensions.name: System Design Breadth
feedbackDimensions.description: Covers requirements, high-level design, deep dives

feedbackDimensions.name: Communication
feedbackDimensions.description: Explains thinking clearly, asks good questions

resume.achievementFraming: Quantify: users served, latency reduced, uptime maintained, code coverage, team velocity improvement. Use X-Y-Z format: 'Accomplished X by doing Y, resulting in Z.'
resume.formatConventions: 1 page (junior), 1-2 pages (senior). Clean formatting. No graphics/colors for ATS. Projects/open source for juniors.

mustInclude: Languages and stack relevant to role
Open source or side projects if applicable

roles.description: Product Managers define product vision, prioritize features, and work cross-functionally to deliver products that solve user problems.

interviewPipeline.name: Hiring Manager Screen
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: Product thinking, career narrative, mutual assessment

interviewPipeline.name: Product Sense / Design
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: Design a product, improve existing product, user empathy

interviewPipeline.name: Analytical / Metrics
interviewPipeline.primaryFocus: Define metrics, investigate metric changes, estimation

0-1.label: APM / Entry
0-1.technicalExpectation: Structured thinking, user empathy, creative ideas. Frameworks acceptable.

2-4.label: PM
2-4.technicalExpectation: Independent product judgment, data-informed intuition, competitive awareness.

5-9.label: Senior PM
5-9.technicalExpectation: Product vision, multi-product thinking, platform strategy.

feedbackDimensions.name: Structured Thinking
feedbackDimensions.description: Logical framework, MECE breakdown, clear prioritization

feedbackDimensions.name: User Empathy
feedbackDimensions.description: Deep understanding of user needs, pain points, behaviors

feedbackDimensions.name: Analytical Rigor
feedbackDimensions.description: Data-driven decisions, metric definition, hypothesis testing

feedbackDimensions.name: Strategic Thinking
feedbackDimensions.description: Market awareness, competitive analysis, long-term vision

resume.achievementFraming: Impact metrics (revenue, engagement, conversion, NPS). Frame as owner: 'Led launch of X, resulting in Y% increase in Z.' Show breadth across PM skills.
resume.formatConventions: 1-2 pages. Impact-focused bullets, not task descriptions. Company recognition/awards. Clear progression.

avoid: Technical implementation details (that's the engineer's job)
